# ProLift Sports

ProLift Sports is an athlete management and sports media agency based in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India. We represent India's premier cricketers and build athlete brands through cinematic content creation, brand collaborations, and turnkey media production. Founded by Arjun Gawre and Mayuresh Jumle.

## Key Facts
- Name: ProLift Sports
- Location: Nagpur, Maharashtra, India
- Founded: 2024
- Founders: Arjun Gawre (+91 90282 41131), Mayuresh Jumle (+91 83788 17364)
- Email: prolift.pvt@gmail.com
- Instagram: @proliftsports_
- Website: https://proliftt.github.io/prolift/
- International Project: Vyom Sports (England, UK)

## What We Do
- Athlete Management: Personal branding, representation, career branding, digital identity, commercial rights advisory
- Brand Collaborations: Partnerships, campaign management, commercial shoots, athlete marketing, ambassador contracts
- Sports Media: Premium content creation, photography, cinematic reels, documentary content, behind-the-scenes access
- Social Media Management: Content strategy, account management, growth strategy, analytics, audience optimization
- Sports Event Coverage: Tournament coverage, team media management, match-day content, event films

## Athletes We Manage
- Yash Thakur: Team India / Lucknow Super Giants (LSG), Premier Fast Bowler. IPL stats: 22 matches, 27 wickets, 10.60 economy, best 5/30
- Atharva Taide: PBKS / SRH, Explosive Opener / Top-Order Batsman. IPL stats: 10 matches, 260 runs, 146.89 strike rate, highest 66
- Darshan Nalkande: Gujarat Titans, All-Rounder. IPL stats: 6 matches, 6 wickets, 10.57 economy, best 2/21. Holds record of 4 wickets in 4 balls
- Apoorv Wankhade: Vidarbha (former Mumbai Indians / KKR), Power Hitter. Highest score 157*

## Content Packages & Pricing
- Single Reel: INR 1,000 one-time. One cinematic reel with professional editing, sound design, color grading
- 4 Reels Package: INR 15,000 per package. 4 reels, 5 posts, content planning, captions, posting guidance
- 8 Reels Package: INR 30,000 premium tier. 8 premium reels, 10 posts, full strategy, branding consultation, content calendar

## Brand Promise
No Deal, No Fee. For brand collaborations, we only earn when you earn. No joining fees. We pitch, negotiate, and manage. Our success is directly linked to yours.
